snippet.title: Salvation Denied – Shield Breaker Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Free Demo Ahead of Steam Next Fest: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4193590/Salvation_Denied

The demo includes two full missions, which provide a complete picture of the variety and diversity in gameplay objectives, challenges, and chaotic events in the game: 

- Mission 1: "Signal to Orbit" - build a base of any shape, get the antenna to hit the signal, and try not to get flattened by meteor showers. 
- Mission 2: "Shield Breaker" - level support heights across the canyon, drive massive damper cores to the mega impulse cannon, and take down three security towers to breach the main barrier. 

Join on Discord → https://discord.gg/salvdeniedgame
Follow on X → https://twitter.com/salvdeniedgame
Watch on TikTok → https://www.tiktok.com/@salvdeniedgame
Explore on Instagram → https://www.instagram.com/salvdeniedgame
